title: Engineering Design Draftsperson - Trainee
abstract: Join our professional, well established business and become part of our friendly supportive team, working on a range of varied, interesting projects.
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
content_text:
Reid Consulting Engineers is a well established Consultant Engineering firm with over 40 years experience in the Toowoomba and surrounding areas.
A vacancy has become available to work, learn and develop a rewarding career in our Toowoomba Design Office.
Applicants for this position should have sound computer keyboard skills, enjoy working in a supportive team environment, have a strong desire to develop a rewarding career within the Building & Construction Industry and will have completed Grade 12 studies.
If this career opportunity appeals to you, applications can be made by sending a brief covering letter and resume to mail@reidconsulting.com.au.
Applications will be treated confidentially. Applicants must have Austrslian citizenship or permanent residency and working status to be successful.  Please note, we are only able to reply to short-listed applicants.
